enonce.texte:
Match the journalistic term with its correct definition.

  • 1. Article
  • 2. Reporter
  • 3. Headline
  • 4. Interview
  • 5. Breaking news

A. A person who gathers and reports news.

B. A conversation where a journalist asks questions.

C. The title of a news story, usually in large letters.

D. Very important news that is happening now.

E. A piece of writing about a news event.

questions.texte: Match the terms to their definitions.

enonce.texte:
Read the news article and answer the questions.

News Article:

"Heavy Rain Causes Flooding in Douala"

Douala, Cameroon – Heavy rain fell in Douala yesterday. The rain started in the morning and continued all day. Many streets are flooded. Cars cannot pass on some roads. Schools and businesses closed early. The government says it will help the affected people. There is no report of injuries.

questions.texte: What is the main topic of the article?
questions.reponse: Heavy rain causing flooding in Douala.

questions.texte: When did the rain start?
questions.reponse: The rain started yesterday morning.

questions.texte: What happened to schools and businesses?
questions.reponse: They closed early.

questions.texte: Did anyone get injured?
questions.reponse: No, there is no report of injuries.

enonce.texte:
Transform these active sentences into passive voice in the simple present.

1. The journalist writes the article.

2. The reporter interviews the president.

3. The editor checks the facts.

4. The newspaper publishes the story.

5. The government announces new laws.

questions.texte: Write the passive form of each sentence.
questions.reponse: 1. The article is written by the journalist. 2. The president is interviewed by the reporter. 3. The facts are checked by the editor. 4. The story is published by the newspaper. 5. New laws are announced by the government.

enonce.texte:
Complete the sentences with words from the box.

Words: journalist, witness, breaking news, headline, broadcast

1. The _______ wrote an interesting story about the election.

2. The police are looking for a _______ who saw the accident.

3. This is _______ : the president is speaking now.

4. The _______ of the newspaper was "Storm Hits City".

5. The TV station will _______ the match live tonight.

questions.texte: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.
questions.reponse: 1. journalist, 2. witness, 3. breaking news, 4. headline, 5. broadcast

enonce.texte:
Read the news story and write a summary in 3-5 sentences.

News Story:

"A fire destroyed a large market in Yaoundé early this morning. The fire started at 3 a.m. and spread quickly. Firefighters arrived quickly but the damage was huge. Many shop owners lost their goods. No one was hurt. The government will help the victims."

questions.texte: Summarize the news story.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
A large market in Yaoundé was destroyed by a fire early this morning. The fire started at 3 a.m. and firefighters could not stop the damage. Many shop owners lost their goods, but no one was hurt. The government will help the victims.

enonce.texte:
Read the sentences and identify if they are in active or passive voice.

1. The newspaper is printed every morning.

2. The journalist writes the news.

3. The story was read by millions of people.

4. The editor checks the articles.

5. The news is broadcasted at 8 p.m.

questions.texte: Write "active" or "passive" for each sentence.
questions.reponse: 1. Passive, 2. Active, 3. Passive, 4. Active, 5. Passive

enonce.texte: Create a newspaper headline for each of the following events. Make it short and catchy.

questions.texte: Event: A new hospital opens in Bamenda.
questions.reponse: Example: "New Hospital Opens in Bamenda" or "Bamenda Gets New Hospital"

questions.texte: Event: A famous singer visits Cameroon.
questions.reponse: Example: "Famous Singer Visits Cameroon" or "Star Arrives in Cameroon"

questions.texte: Event: A football team wins the championship.
questions.reponse: Example: "Team Wins Championship" or "Champions: Team Victorious!"

enonce.texte:
Read the article and answer True or False.

Article:

"The President of Cameroon visited the city of Bafoussam yesterday. He met with local officials and visited a new school. The president spoke about the importance of education. He promised to build more schools in rural areas. Thousands of people came to see him."

questions.texte: The President visited Bafoussam yesterday.
questions.reponse: True

questions.texte: He visited a new hospital.
questions.reponse: False (He visited a new school.)

questions.texte: He promised to build more schools.
questions.reponse: True

questions.texte: Only a few people came to see him.
questions.reponse: False (Thousands of people came.)

enonce.texte: Create a passive voice question for each answer.

questions.texte: Answer: The article is written by the editor.
questions.reponse: Who is the article written by? / Is the article written by the editor?

questions.texte: Answer: The news is broadcasted every evening.
questions.reponse: When is the news broadcasted?

questions.texte: Answer: The story was published yesterday.
questions.reponse: When was the story published?

enonce.texte: You are a journalist reporting on an event in your town. Write a short news report (5-7 sentences) about something that happened. Use at least one passive voice sentence and include a headline.

questions.texte: Write a complete news report.
questions.reponse:
Example answer: 
"New Library Opens in Maroua"
A new library opened in Maroua yesterday. The ceremony was attended by the mayor and many people. The library was built with help from the government. It is located near the market. Students are very happy. It is a great addition to the city.
